title: UglyGlass
body:
# Ugly Glass Mod
Wait… all glass has turned back into the old texture? That looks awful!!
Let’s explore the reason behind it.
![glass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6be03681eb9e95b0a4a0ba4ec6aca925c9098162_0.webp)

## “Ugly Glass” Saves Lives
Adding visible patterns to glass can help birds avoid collisions.
1. That’s right—Minecraft’s classic glass texture is actually a bird-friendly design.
2. Those little pixel patterns are a hidden lifesaver!
3. This mod not only restores the old glass texture, but also introduces several alternative bird-safe glass designs.
4. These are inspired by real-world solutions, and are accompanied by in-game text that provides additional educational information.
